question: Whom among the following Indian classical musicians is an auditorium in Teheran, Iran named after?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Bismillah Khan. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian musician Ustad Bismillah Khan **is recognised for popularising the reeded** woodwind instrument shehnai.**
 
• In **2001**, he received the** Bharat Ratna** along with **Lata Mangeshkar.**
 
• In **Teheran, Iran,** there is a theatre with his name on it.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Sultan Khan:**

 
 
• **Indian classical singer and sarangi playe**r Ustad Sultan Khan belonged to the **Sikar Gharana.**
 
• Together with** Bill Laswell and Zakir Hussain**, he was a founding member of the **Indian fusion band Tabla Beat Science.**
 
• In **2010,** he received the **Padma Bhushan honor.**
 
 
 
• **Ustad Zakir Hussain:**
 
 
• **Tabla musician, composer, percussionist, music producer, **and actor Ustad Zakir Hussain hails from India.
 
• In **1988,** he received the **Padma Shri, in 2002,** the Padma Bhushan, and in **2023**, the Padma Vibhushan.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Vilayat Khan:**
 
 
• Indian** classical sitarist **Ustad Vilayat Khan played the instrument.​ 
 
• He is given the credit for inventing and perfecting** gayaki ang on the sitar.**
 
• Vilayat received the** Padma Bhushan** award in **1968** and the **Padma Shri **award in** 1964, **respectively.
